rule:
PHD-MAIN-STAGE3-v1 5.5: the places of the figures, fixed before any training (jointbuildgs:dev, CPU; run_cpu3.sh). Rules (written
before they were run; the places come from the region files only, never from a result):
  ex31  3-1 example (the fewest author condition B0a3): the LoD2 wall surface with the most GT points in its invisible-agreement patches
        (code 5, wall-like, in the evaluation range) of B0a3's region file; drawn front-on (outward normal), the same surface and view in
        every condition
  ex33  3-3 example: a place observed as prior error (code 11); first rule: code 11 in all seven region files (영상 전체 + the six; the
        patch store is the B0 box's in all) -> none; changed at 10-14 10:20 (before any training, on the region files only; see ex33's
        text): code 11 in 영상 전체 and B0a3 (the two drawn), pieces >= 1 m2 (patch centres within 0.5 m), the one common to the most
        conditions, ties by GT points. Section: 12 m through the piece's GT-weighted centre, along the roof-plane steepest-descent
        direction of its face (a flat face: along the piece's longer extent), +-0.25 m wide
  map34 3-4 pair map: the 13-view pair (저자 15장 B0a15 vs 연직 포함 13장 B0n13), top view of the B0 box evaluation range, support
        agreement (code 2) in one colour
  r1miss 8.5: R1 LoD2 and R1 ALS missing-agreement (code 4) region, top view of the R1 box; section through the R1 LoD2 code-4 piece with
        the most GT points (12 m, along its longer extent)
  reused (stage 1 / 2 definitions, same place and view): 보강-1 example and 8.4 = stage 2 figdefs 'loss/R1rep_b10/LoD2' (the loss-judgment
        piece, 2,621 patches); 보강-2 = stage 1 sections_v1 'B173_wing' (12 m, +-0.25 m) and VIS v3 'a_fate' wing seeds; 보강-4 = stage 2
        figdefs 'protect/B173nb_b10/LoD2' (the long wall, front view)
  python figpos_s3.py   -> S3/prep/figpos.json
scientific_verdict: null.

ex31.rule: B0a3 invisible-agreement wall surface with the most GT points
ex31.view: front-on, outward normal of the surface, the same in every condition

ex33.rule:
first rule (code 11 in all seven) found no patch, and the most-conditions variant one 0.06 m2 patch (B0n2 missing); the figure shows
    영상 전체 and B0a3 only, so the place must be code 11 in those two: their common code-11 pieces (>= 1 m2), the piece common (majority of
    its patches code 11) to the most conditions, ties by GT points. The conditions where it is not code 11 are written.

r1miss.map: top view of the R1 box evaluation range: the missing-agreement patches coloured by the origin of the Gaussian in front (8.5)

loss/R1rep_b10/LoD2.why: loss: roof-like prior error judged conflict, tau < |GT - prior| <= 4 tau

protect/B173nb_b10/LoD2.cells: the 'inferred correct' unseen patches (unseen.npz label 0); colour = wall present (an opaque Gaussian within 0.25 m)

reused.B173_wing: configs/phd/main_stage1_v1/sections_v1.json B173_wing (12 m, +-0.25 m); VIS v3 measures.a_fate wing seeds
